'''Irella''' is an [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]].

== Appearance ==
She is skinny{{ref/book|2|38}} and lanky with a permanent frown{{ref/book|2|39}}.
== Activities ==
[[Nynaeve al'Meara]] clouts Irella over the ear, resulting in Nynaeve being sent to [[Mistress of Novices]]{{ref/book|2|38}}. She is disciplining Else when Nynaeve, Elayne, Egwene and Min leave the White Tower and fails to notice them{{ref/book|2|39}}.
